summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc. filed a Form 6-K on September 2, 2026, disclosing a conversion agreement with two CLA Investors converting $687,500 principal plus accrued interest ($696,079.50 total) of convertible promissory notes into common shares at an agreed price of $1.00 per share, and amending the notes' floor price to $1.00. This is a routine financing event—conversion of existing debt—not a special-situation corporate action. The filing is an ordinary securities issuance update, with no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or structural overhang beyond the conversion. Watch for further conversions under the remaining $10 million SPA facility, but no risk-arb angle exists.
